_comment: Where the update check asks, and the limits it asks under. `source` is the repository's
release page, which answers with a redirect to the newest tag; that redirect is the whole
answer and it is not followed. The check sends nothing the reader owns: no key, no auth
header, no query, no install identifier, and no words or selection text.
The download path is what a reader who presses Download on the card uses. `sumsName` is the
asset that publishes the SHA256 of the installer; a release without it is not downloadable,
which is the fail-closed direction. `maxDownloadBytes` caps one installer, `stallTimeoutMs`
gives up on a transfer that stops moving, `connectTimeoutMs` gives up on one that never
starts. A download that never got a single byte is reported with the proxy text, and one
that moved and then stopped is reported without it. A download is written to the reader's own local
cache and is launched only after its digest has been checked twice: once when it lands and
once just before it is run.
Nothing is installed silently: the installer is run with no arguments at all.
